    r1 = b

    s1 = 0
    t0 = 0
    t1 = 1
    while r1:
        q = r0 // r1
        r0, r1 = r1, r0 - q*r1
        s0, s1 = s1, s0 - q*s1
        t0, t1 = t1, t0 - q*t1
    return r0, s0
